No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Adamawa PAWECA Releases List Of Successful Candidates, Schedules Needs Assessment For November 5 by LEADERSHIP News 29 minutes ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Adamawa State Poverty Alleviation and Wealth Creation Agency (PAWECA) has released the list of successful candidates who participated in the entrance examination for admission into its Technical and Skills Acquisition Centres across the state.
In a public announcement issued by the agency’s management, applicants were advised to check the notice boards at their respective Local Government Area Secretariats to confirm their admission status.
The agency also announced that a needs assessment exercise for successful candidates will take place on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at the respective centres where the entrance examinations were conducted.
According to PAWECA, the exercise is designed to assess the preparedness of successful candidates for their various technical and vocational skills acquisition programmes.
The management urged all successful candidates to participate in the exercise as scheduled.
